findings.motion: HB 958, Election Law Changes, second reading
findings.note: Roll call lists Jeffers among the No votes (66 to 47). The bill digest says the bill extends the time to show ID after a provisional ballot, requires photo ID or an affidavit for overseas military ballots, requires an affirmative citizenship statement on voter registration, limits who may hand-deliver an absentee ballot, and changes removal of non-citizens from voter rolls. Digest: https://webservices.ncleg.gov/BillDigests/2025/H958

findings.motion: HB 958, Election Law Changes, motion to concur with the Senate version
findings.note: Roll call lists Jeffers among the No votes (62 to 47). Same bill as above; the bill was later vetoed by the Governor on 2026-08-17 per https://www.ncleg.gov/BillLookUp/2025/H958.

findings.motion: Third Reading, SB 921 Const. Am./Require Photo ID For All Voters (House roll call #810, 73 ayes, 45 noes)
findings.note: House third-reading vote on SB 921, a state constitutional amendment requiring photo ID for all voters. The roll call transcript lists Ray Jeffers among the noes. The bill became SL 2024-58.
